publicApplication.protocolLimits: The native polygon endpoint and field bindings are verified from the served first-party application bundle. No live /v1/khasramap/plot readback was possible without a verified parcel id; authenticated editing/import routes were not used.

selectorEvidence.provenance: Existing first-party request evidence in city-9279-etawah.json and etawah-service-review.json.

nativePolygon.assessment: The checked city selectors have no map extent and the WUP point is outside the two checked nonzero nearby extents; no source-native polygon or parcel id was verified.

Both city-named selectors are flagged as having no map data; the checked selector has a zero extent and exact-point identify returned an empty object. No source-native polygon or parcel id was verified.

selectorEvidence.provenance: Village list and tehsil-level identify evidence in city-9883-raebareli.json and raebareli-service-review.json; fresh anonymous identify on 2026-10-09.

nativePolygon.assessment: The tehsil has 358 village selectors but none matched the city name. Tehsil-depth identify returned an empty object; no village selector or source-native polygon was verified at the exact point.

overallAssessment: The official public application exposes a native polygon readback route, but none of these three point checks yielded a verified parcel id that could be safely read back as a full polygon. These results mean unverified within the checked selector/point scope, not confirmed parcel absence or citywide incompleteness.
